name: Women's CAP dark blue polo long sleeves, screen-printed CAP seal in white on the left breast (overlay, registered to garment-polo-female-long)
size_basis: The CAP seal asset insignia-cap-seal (the official seal vector, Fig A6-4 size) reduced to a single white print, layer by layer from the official file's own classes: the gold rings, the lettering, the 13 stars, the triangle and the eagle solid white, the cloud and torse as outlines, the shield as a white outline, the white band, the gray field and the propeller in the shirt colour (#151f3b, sampled in-browser from the CAP wing page photo set "Male / Female Corporate Working Uniforms" (https://ftsnelling.cap.gov/media/cms/_Corporate_Working_header_9930F3D215143.jpg, 1900 x 1165; screenshot kept as base-art/polo-ref/ref2_corporate-working-photoset_screenshot.jpg); dark blue pixels over the whole photo set (knit and tactical, short and long, men's and women's mannequins), n = 668,936: shadow p0-p10 #0e1123, body p30-p70 #151f3b, lit p85-p97 #404b6e, p50 #1b1d34, p95 #485781. Body = the p30-p70 mean, lit tone = the p85-p97 mean (stitch and fold lines only), shadow / outline = the p0-p10 mean. The guidance drawing's flat #001a53 and Figure 5.5's #001b52 are the drawings' fills, not cloth, and are not used; the earlier single-photo sample #171b1f (Vanguard CAP0321_1.jpg) was a near-black with almost no blue and is replaced.). Diameter 2.93 in = the embroidered seal measured on Figure 5.5 (the printed polo has no figure of its own and no photograph is on disk; ESTIMATE that the print is the same size), centred on the wearer's left breast at the mirror of the embroidered seal's position about the centre line (print_seal_slot of garment-polo-female-long). CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.2 says "screen-printed in white lettering on the left breast" and no accoutrements (5.3.2.1.2).
documented: dark blue knit polo with the CAP seal screen-printed in white on the left breast, long or short sleeves (CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.2)
no accoutrements: no name, badge or embroidered seal (5.3.2.1.2)
assumed: which seal parts print solid, as outline or are knocked out (single-colour reduction of the official seal vector, seal-from-official.js print())
